slides.title: A first book of the world
slides.transcript: [warmly] Allah Made It. A first book of the world, for Yusuf. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] Eight things you can see from where you are lying.

slides.title: The Sky
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Sky. <break time="0.4s" /> Wide and blue and nothing holding it up. It is there every single morning when you look. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Allah is the Maker of everything.

slides.title: The Sea
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Sea. <break time="0.4s" /> It comes up the sand and goes back again, all day and all night, and never once forgets. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Allah is the Maker of everything.

slides.title: The Date Palm
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Date Palm. <break time="0.4s" /> Tall, with its feet in the sand, holding up a hundred sweet dates for whoever walks past. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Allah is the Maker of everything.

slides.title: The Bee
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Bee. <break time="0.4s" /> Smaller than your thumb, and it knows the way to every flower and the way home again. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Allah is the Maker of everything.

slides.title: The Bird
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Bird. <break time="0.4s" /> It leaves the branch with nothing underneath it at all, and the air holds it up anyway. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Allah is the Maker of everything.

slides.title: The Cat
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Cat. <break time="0.4s" /> Four soft feet that make no sound at all, and eyes that can see in the dark better than yours. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Allah is the Maker of everything.

slides.title: The Moon and the Stars
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Moon and the Stars. <break time="0.4s" /> A thin white curve, and behind it more stars than anyone has ever finished counting. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Allah is the Maker of everything.

slides.title: The Rain
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Rain. <break time="0.4s" /> It goes up without anyone seeing, and comes down again on the dry ground, and the ground turns green. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Allah is the Maker of everything.

slides.title: And You
slides.transcript: [softly] And You. <break time="0.4s" /> The sky, the sea, the palm, the bee, the bird, the cat, the moon, the rain — and one small boy in a blanket. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Goodnight, Yusuf.
